description:
## Tantan 7.5.4 — patch expansion wave (privacy + telemetry + promo)

- Privacy: contacts upload gate, clipboard invite-code reads (live/campaign/Sud), MK H5 app-enumeration bridge blocked
- WebView mixed-content forced NEVER_ALLOW at all 7 sites (shared-register-safe dead-scratch insert)
- Telemetry: push click/delivery tracker, remote xlog pull handler, Firebase Sessions, WiFi MAC, FB app-settings fetch disabled
- Beatles/xlog residual FIXED: re-anchored to h53 (old anchor absent in 7.5.4) + luw.m upload choke voided
- RemoteConfig: 11 promo JSON overrides, 9 count limits relaxed, profile-voice enabled, superlike pop thresholds 999
- Superlike upsell bubbles + post-swipe Suggesters interrupt suppressed
- Town Tales casual-game promo removed: menu fetch gate voided, display gate false, Me-tab floating entrance hidden
- Quick Chat tickets unlocked (200000 / active); voice-message 60s cap lifted to Long.MAX_VALUE
- AB: j0 regs=2 silent no-op fixed — 3 promo-off keys added, 5 pre-existing overrides now live
- All 16 patches apply to 7.5.4 (2754010); every new/changed target DEX-verified; PatchVerificationTest green
